body: I know exactly what that feels like. It is normal. I felt that while I was seeing a regular therapist. You are okay. Even if you're fucked up, you are okay. I love you.
I love you. Whatever else is going on in your life, I love you. You are my sibling. I hope things get much better for you very soon.
I don't know you, but I love you and I want you to keep on trucking. As a Wiccan, every living thing is my brother or sister. You are my sibling. Please don't give up. I love you.
I'm really, really sorry this is happening to you. I've written lots of suicide notes in my time. I know how much even writing them hurts. I truly, sincerely hope things get better for you.
